correctness.rationale: An independent set occupies at most one vertex per rung; occupied adjacent rungs must alternate layers. This establishes the exact maxima and number of configurations, the two exchanges of each odd maximum, and both checkerboard deletion cliques for even n. For n−2 every state has exactly two vacant columns and is counted by adjacent/nonadjacent vacancy pairs. Moving a vacancy towards the other preserves independence and produces adjacent vacancies, which connect through overlap of odd maximum-state cliques or explicit even checkerboard bridge. Both exhaustive distinct-encoding programs independently check all claims for n=3,...,10; symbolic argument is required for all n.

value.rationale: The standard cubic planar prism family illustrates a sharp parity-dependent obstacle to token-jumping optimum independent configurations: the odd optimum space is a cycle; the even optimum space is two isolated points and the one-slack space two disjoint cliques; yet the two-vacancy space is always connected, with exactly 2n(n−2) states. This provides an exact structural and constructive boundary for optimal/near-optimal independent-set reconfiguration, rather than a routine independence-number calculation.
